title: Spurious Goods
description: Definition of Spurious Goods under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: such goods which are falsely claimed to be genuine
content.plain_language: goods that are fake or falsely claimed to be authentic
examples: a counterfeit luxury watch sold as a genuine product
a fake medicine claiming to be from a reputable brand
non_examples: a genuine product with a manufacturing defect
a used product sold as used

user_queries: What is meant by spurious goods?
How are spurious goods defined under the Consumer Protection Act?
